output.summary: A deciduous tree native to mainland Africa, the African baobab has an exceptionally broad trunk that may comprise several stems fused around a hollow core. It can remain leafless for about eight months in the dry season, while its large white hanging flowers stay open and fertile for only one night.
output.edibilityNote: Traditionally eaten in Africa: roots and fruit are edible; dry fruit pulp is soaked for juice, and young leaves are cooked.
